crossRefs.note: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
“Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
translations.bsb: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
translations.kjv: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
translations.asv: Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.
